headline: Robby Fabbri signs tryout contract with AHL’s Hamilton Hammers
take:
Daily Faceoff reports Robby Fabbri has signed a professional tryout with the AHL's Hamilton Hammers, who also brought in former Dallas Stars prospect Antonio Stranges on a PTO.

For Fabbri, the 2014 first-round pick of the St. Louis Blues, this is a road back rather than a destination: a tryout lets him show he is healthy and sharp without a contract attached. Stranges never broke through in Dallas, and the Stars haven't needed him to. They are 9-5-2 and have allowed just 36 goals on 44.05 expected, while their shooters have scored about four fewer goals than their chances deserved.

Neither signing moves an NHL needle today. Both are worth a glance in a month, when injuries start to pile up around the league.
